items.summary: Connects the Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and OpenCode agents running in Herdr across your laptop, desktop and VMs. Check each agent's status and output from your phone or any MCP client such as ChatGPT, and message a specific agent directly; when an agent needs a decision it sends you a Telegram note you can answer from your phone. The client only makes outbound connections to the relay — nothing connects in — and machines can be shared read-only with teammates. Requires Node.js 22.13+ and Herdr 0.9.3+.
items.title: PeerBand: reach the coding agents on all your machines from your phone — Telegram pings you when an agent needs a decision (Product Hunt, Nov 25)

items.summary: An open-source local training engine that sits between a coding agent (opencode, pi, or any OpenAI-compatible tool) and a locally served model (Ollama, mlx-lm, LM Studio, vLLM, llama.cpp). While you work it records what follows each model action — tool results, errors, your corrections — and when the agent goes quiet it runs a Dream: a Quick Dream folds your stated preferences into the model's instructions in minutes, while a Deep Dream writes practice scenes from those lessons and trains a small adapter by on-policy self-distillation, adopting the new version only if it clearly beats the old one. Training runs on Apple Silicon via MLX or NVIDIA/AMD via PyTorch; everything stays local, no account, no telemetry. Early alpha (0.1.0a13).
items.title: Songe: your local model reviews its own work while idle — learning from agent corrections and errors (open-sourced Nov 20, Apache-2.0)

items.summary: A managed platform that gives each AI teammate its own cloud computer: pick an agent engine (OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Pi, Claude Code, Codex or DeepSeek Harness), assign a role, tools and skills, and share memory across the team. Hand out work from the web, Slack, Telegram or WhatsApp, and agents keep running scheduled and long-running tasks after you close your laptop. Subscription pricing, with model usage billed separately.
items.title: MyClaw 3.0: build an always-on AI team on cloud computers — they keep working after you close your laptop (Product Hunt, Nov 25)
